question_translations.question_text: Whenever you stop for a break during your trip, you should
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: B. check critical items such as the tires, brakes, and cargo tie-downs.

question_translations.question_text: Siempre que se detenga para un descanso durante su viaje, debe
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: verifique elementos críticos como los neumáticos, los frenos y los amarres de carga.

question_translations.question_text: High beams should be:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: A. Used whenever it is safe and legal to do so

question_translations.question_text: Las luces altas deben ser:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Se usa siempre que sea seguro y legal hacerlo

question_translations.question_text: The safety release valve is located on the Air tanks and does what?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: B. Self-operated when the air pressure is above 150 PSI

question_translations.question_text: La válvula de liberación de seguridad está ubicada en los tanques de aire y ¿qué?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Auto-operado cuando la presión del aire es superior a 150 PSI

question_translations.question_text: Which of these is a proper use of vehicle lights and flashers?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: D. All answers are correct

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estos es un uso adecuado de las luces y luces intermitentes del vehículo?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Todas las respuestas son correctas

question_translations.question_text: Which of the following is a crucial steering component?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: A. Gear box

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de los siguientes es un componente de dirección crucial?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Caja de cambios

question_translations.question_text: How can you start moving without rolling backward?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: D. Do all the above.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cómo puedes empezar a moverte sin rodar hacia atrás?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Haga todo lo anterior.

question_translations.question_text: Which is NOT one of the four basic skills that are operating a commercial motor vehicle requires?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: C. First-aid certification

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál NO es una de las cuatro habilidades básicas que requiere operar un vehículo motorizado comercial?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Certificación de primeros auxilios

question_translations.question_text: What is the average reaction distance?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: B. 61 feet

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál es la distancia media de reacción?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 61 pies

question_translations.question_text: The most common cause of severe vehicle skids is:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: A. Driving too fast for road conditions

question_translations.question_text: La causa más común de derrapes graves del vehículo es:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Conducir demasiado rápido para las condiciones de la carretera

question_translations.question_text: The distance you should look ahead of your vehicle while driving amounts to about _ _ _____ at highway speed.
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: C. 1/4 mile

question_translations.question_text: La distancia que debe mirar por delante de su vehículo mientras conduce asciende a aproximadamente _ _ _____ a velocidad de autopista.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 1/4 milla

question_translations.question_text: You must park on the side of a level, straight, two-lane road. Where should you place the three reflective triangles?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: B. One within 10 feet of the rear of the vehicle, one about 100 feet to the rear, and one about 100 feet from the front of the vehicle

question_translations.question_text: Si debe estacionar al costado de una carretera nivelada, recta, de dos carriles. ¿Dónde debes colocar los tres triángulos reflectantes?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Uno dentro de los 10 pies de la parte trasera del vehículo, uno a unos 100 pies de la parte trasera y uno a unos 100 pies de la parte delantera del vehículo

question_translations.question_text: If you are convicted for driving under the influence while driving a commercial vehicle, and this is your first offense, you will most likely get:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: B. At least a one-year suspension of your CDL

question_translations.question_text: Si usted es condenado por conducir bajo la influencia mientras conduce un vehículo comercial, y esta es su primera ofensa, lo más probable es que obtenga:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Al menos una suspensión de un año de su CDL

question_translations.question_text: Front end header boards:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: B. Protect you from your cargo in case of collision and block the forward movement of your cargo

question_translations.question_text: Tableros de cabecera frontal:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Protegerlo de su carga en caso de colisión y bloquear el movimiento hacia adelante de su carga

question_translations.question_text: The formula for stopping distance with air brakes is?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: C . Perception distance, reaction distance, brake lag distance, and effective braking distance

question_translations.question_text: ¿La fórmula para la distancia de frenado con frenos de aire es?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Distancia de percepción, distancia de reacción, distancia de retardo de frenado y distancia de frenado efectiva

question_translations.question_text: Which of these statements about driving in areas with strong winds is true?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: C. Winds are especially a problem when coming out of tunnels

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estas afirmaciones sobre conducir en áreas con vientos fuertes es cierta?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Los vientos son especialmente un problema al salir de los túneles

question_translations.question_text: Which of these statements about crossing or entering traffic with a heavy vehicle is true?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: A. Heavy vehicles need larger gaps in traffic than cars

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estas afirmaciones sobre cruzar o entrar en el tráfico con un vehículo pesado es cierta?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Los vehículos pesados necesitan mayores brechas en el tráfico que los automóviles

question_translations.question_text: If a vehicle continues to drive in your blind spot, you should?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: C. Back off

question_translations.question_text: Si un vehículo continúa conduciendo en su punto ciego, ¿debería hacerlo?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Retroceder

question_translations.question_text: You are driving a 40-foot vehicle at 45 mph. Driving conditions are ideal. What is the least amount of space you should keep in front of your vehicle to be safe?

question_translations.question_text: ¿Dónde debe estar su llave de contacto durante su inspección previa al viaje?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: En tu bolsillo

question_translations.question_text: Truck escape ramps:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: A. Are designed to protect vehicles from damage

question_translations.question_text: Rampas de escape para camiones:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Están diseñados para proteger los vehículos de daños

question_translations.question_text: You are starting your vehicle in motion from a stop; as you apply power to the drive wheels, they start to spin. You should:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: A. Take your foot off the accelerator

question_translations.question_text: Está arrancando su vehículo en movimiento desde una parada; A medida que aplicas potencia a las ruedas motrices, comienzan a girar. Usted debe:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Quita el pie del acelerador

question_translations.question_text: Oil and water usually collect in compressed air tanks. If you do not have an automatic tank drain, when should you drain the air tanks?
question_translations.explanation: If your vehicle does not have automatic air tank drains, drain your air tanks at the end of each working day to remove moisture and oil. Otherwise, the brakes could fail.

question_translations.question_text: El aceite y el agua generalmente se acumulan en tanques de aire comprimido. Si no tiene un drenaje automático del tanque, ¿cuándo debe drenar los tanques de aire?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Después de cada día laborable.

question_translations.question_text: What is the S-cam used for?
question_translations.explanation: When you push the brake pedal, air is let into each brake chamber. Air pressure pushes the rod out, moving the slack adjuster, thus twisting the brake camshaft. This turns the s-cam forcing the brake shoes away from one another and presses them against the inside of the brake drum.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Para qué se utiliza la S-cam?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Para aplicar los frenos.

question_translations.question_text: Which of the following makes the total stopping distance for air brakes longer than for hydraulic brakes?
question_translations.explanation: With air brakes there is an added delay or Brake Lag. This is the time required for the brakes to work after the brake pedal is pushed. With hydraulic brake, the brakes work instantly. With air brakes it takes a little time, one half second or more, for the air to flow through the lines to the brakes.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de las siguientes opciones hace que la distancia total de frenado para los frenos neumáticos sea más larga que para los frenos hidráulicos?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Distancia de retardo del freno.

question_translations.question_text: The brake system that applies and releases the brakes when the driver uses the brake pedal is the:
question_translations.explanation: The service brake system applies and releases the brakes when you use the brake pedal during normal driving.

question_translations.question_text: El sistema de frenos que aplica y libera los frenos cuando el conductor usa el pedal del freno es:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Sistema de frenos de servicio.

question_translations.question_text: To make an emergency stop with air brakes, using the stab braking method, you should:
question_translations.explanation: Stab braking means that you: apply your brakes all the way, and release brakes when wheels lock up. As soon as the wheels start rolling, apply the brakes fully again.

question_translations.question_text: Para hacer una parada de emergencia con frenos de aire, utilizando el método de frenado de puñalada, debe:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Frene tan fuerte como pueda, quite los frenos cuando las ruedas se bloqueen, vuelva a pisar los frenos cuando las ruedas comiencen a rodar nuevamente.

question_translations.question_text: Brake lag distance at 55 mph is _____ feet?
question_translations.explanation: The air brake lag distance at 55 mph on dry pavement adds about 32 feet.

question_translations.question_text: ¿La distancia de retraso del freno a 55 mph es _____ pies?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 32

question_translations.question_text: If your vehicle has an alcohol evaporator, it is there to:
question_translations.explanation: Some air brake systems have an alcohol evaporator to put alcohol into the air system. This helps to reduce the risk of ice in air brake valves and other parts during cold weather. Daily air tank drainage is still needed to get rid of water and oil.

question_translations.question_text: Si su vehículo tiene un evaporador de alcohol, está ahí para:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Reduzca el riesgo de hielo en las válvulas de freno de aire en climas fríos.

question_translations.question_text: What can legally hold parking or emergency brake in position for a truck, truck tractor, or bus?
question_translations.explanation: All trucks, truck tractors, and buses must be equipped with emergency brakes and parking brakes. They must be held on by mechanical force because air pressure can eventually leak away. Spring brakes are usually used to meet these needs.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Qué puede mantener legalmente el estacionamiento o el freno de emergencia en posición para un camión, camión tractor o autobús?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Presión del resorte

question_translations.question_text: The braking power of the spring brakes:
question_translations.explanation: The braking power of spring brakes depends on the brakes being in adjustment. If the brakes are not adjusted properly, neither the regular brakes nor the emergency/parking brakes will work right.

question_translations.question_text: La potencia de frenado de los frenos de resorte:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Depende del ajuste de los frenos de servicio.

question_translations.question_text: Which of the following should you do before leaving your vehicle unattended?
question_translations.explanation: Never leave your vehicle unattended without applying the parking brakes or chocking the wheels. Your vehicle might roll away and cause injury and damage

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de las siguientes acciones debe hacer antes de dejar su vehículo desatendido?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Haga todo lo anterior.

question_translations.question_text: Under which conditions are front-wheel brakes good?
question_translations.explanation: Front wheel brakes have been shown to be ideal under all weather and driving conditions. Front wheel braking is unlikely to cause a skid even on icy roads.

question_translations.question_text: ¿En qué condiciones son buenos los frenos de las ruedas delanteras?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Todas las condiciones climáticas

question_translations.question_text: If the air tanks are not drained,
question_translations.explanation: Compressed air usually has some water and some compressor oil in it, which is bad for the air brake system. For example, the water can freeze in cold weather and cause brake failure.

question_translations.question_text: Si los tanques de aire no están drenados,
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: sus frenos pueden fallar debido a la congelación del agua.

question_translations.question_text: An antilock braking system (ABS)
question_translations.explanation: ABS is a computerized system that keeps your wheels from locking up during hard brake applications.

question_translations.question_text: Un sistema de frenos antibloqueo (ABS)
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: se activa cuando las ruedas están a punto de bloquearse.

question_translations.question_text: Which of the following can cause brakes to fade or fail?
question_translations.explanation: Brakes can fade or fail from excessive heat caused by using them too much and not relying on the engine braking effect. Brake fade is also affected by adjustment.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de los siguientes puede hacer que los frenos se desvanezcan o fallen?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Todo lo anterior

question_translations.question_text: What is the best way to test if your vehicle's spring brakes come on automatically?
question_translations.explanation: On both tractor-trailers and single vehicles, to test whether the spring brakes will come on automatically, use the same method you use for testing the low air pressure warning signal: Step on and off the brake pedal, this time until you reach an even lower psi reading and the parking brake valve closes or pops out.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál es la mejor manera de probar si los frenos de resorte de su vehículo se activan automáticamente?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Todo lo anterior es correcto.

question_translations.question_text: If your vehicle has a properly functioning dual air brake system and minimum-sized air tanks, the air pressure should build from 85 to 100 psi within ____ seconds.
question_translations.explanation: When the engine is at operating rpms, the pressure should build from 85 to 100 psi within 45 seconds in dual air systems. If the vehicle has larger than minimum air tanks, the buildup time can be longer and still be safe.

question_translations.question_text: Si su vehículo tiene un sistema de frenos de aire doble que funciona correctamente y tanques de aire de tamaño mínimo, la presión de aire debe aumentar de 85 a 100 psi en ____ segundos.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 45

question_translations.question_text: The air compressor will stop pumping air into the air tanks at ____ psi.
question_translations.explanation: The governor controls when the air compressor will pump air into the air storage tanks. When air tank pressure rises to the "cut-out" level around 125 psi, the governor stops the compressor from pumping air. When the tank pressure falls to the "cut-in" pressure around 100 psi, the governor allows the compressor to start pumping again.

question_translations.question_text: El compresor de aire dejará de bombear aire a los tanques de aire a ____ psi.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 125

question_translations.question_text: Excessive heat caused by overuse of the service brakes can cause
question_translations.explanation: Brakes can fade or fail from excessive heat caused by using them too much and not relying on the engine braking effect.

question_translations.question_text: El calor excesivo causado por el uso excesivo de los frenos de servicio puede causar
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: los frenos se desvanecen.

question_translations.question_text: Excessive use of the service brakes may result in overheating, leading to
question_translations.explanation: Brake fade results from excessive heat causing chemical changes in the brake lining, which reduce friction, and also causing expansion of the brake drums.

question_translations.question_text: El uso excesivo de los frenos de servicio puede provocar un sobrecalentamiento, lo que provocará
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: expansión de los tambores de freno.

question_translations.question_text: A typical air brake system is fully charged at
question_translations.explanation: Pumping by the air compressor should start at about 100 psi and stop at about 125 psi.

question_translations.question_text: Un sistema de frenos de aire típico está completamente cargado a
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 125 psi.

question_translations.question_text: During normal driving, spring brakes are usually held back by
question_translations.explanation: Parking or emergency brakes must be held on by mechanical force because air pressure can eventually leak away. Spring brakes are usually used to meet these needs. When driving, powerful springs are held back by air pressure.

question_translations.question_text: Durante la conducción normal, los frenos de resorte generalmente se retrasan por
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: presión de aire.

question_translations.question_text: During your final air brake check, if the air pressure does not build up fast enough,
question_translations.explanation: If air pressure does not build up fast enough, your pressure may drop too low during driving, requiring an emergency stop. Don't drive until you get the problem fixed.

question_translations.question_text: Durante la comprobación final de los frenos de aire, si la presión del aire no aumenta lo suficientemente rápido,
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: la presión del aire puede bajar demasiado durante la conducción.

question_translations.question_text: To test the static air leakage rate, you should
question_translations.explanation: With a fully-charged air system (typically 125 psi), turn off the engine, release the parking brake (push in); and time the air pressure drop.

question_translations.question_text: Para probar la tasa de fuga de aire estático, debe
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: apague el motor, suelte el freno de estacionamiento y deje que el sistema se asiente.

question_translations.question_text: Air brakes use _________ to make the brakes work.
question_translations.explanation: Air brakes use compressed air to make the brakes work. Air brakes are a good and safe way of stopping large and heavy vehicles, but the brakes must be well maintained and used properly.

question_translations.question_text: Los frenos de aire usan ______ para hacer que los frenos funcionen.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: aire comprimido

question_translations.question_text: When you press the brake pedal,
question_translations.explanation: When you push the brake pedal, air is let into each brake chamber.

question_translations.question_text: Al pisar el pedal del freno,
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: el aire comprimido entra en las cámaras de freno.

question_translations.question_text: The air compressor governor controls:
question_translations.explanation: The governor controls when the air compressor will pump air into the air storage tanks. When air tank pressure rises to the "cut-out" level around 125 psi, the governor stops the compressor from pumping air. When the tank pressure falls to the "cut-in" pressure around 100 psi, the governor allows the compressor to start pumping again.

question_translations.question_text: El regulador del compresor de aire controla:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Cuando se bombea aire a los tanques de aire.

question_translations.question_text: Of the choices below, the first thing to do when a low air pressure warning comes on is:
question_translations.explanation: When the low air pressure warning light and buzzer first come on, bring the vehicle to a safe stop right away, while you can still control the brakes.

question_translations.question_text: De las opciones a continuación, lo primero que debe hacer cuando se enciende una advertencia de baja presión de aire es:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Deténgase y estacione de manera segura lo antes posible.

question_translations.question_text: Air brake equipped vehicles must have:
question_translations.explanation: All vehicles with air brakes have a pressure gauge connected to the air tank. If the vehicle has a dual air brake system, there will be a gauge for each half of the system.

question_translations.question_text: Los vehículos equipados con frenos de aire deberán tener:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Un manómetro de suministro.

question_translations.question_text: Modern air brake systems combines three different systems. They are the service brakes, the parking brakes, and the:
question_translations.explanation: Air brakes are really three different braking systems: service brake, parking brake, and emergency brake.

question_translations.question_text: Los sistemas modernos de frenos de aire combinan tres sistemas diferentes. Son los frenos de servicio, los frenos de estacionamiento y:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Frenos de emergencia.

question_translations.question_text: If you must make an emergency stop, you should brake so that you:
question_translations.explanation: You should brake in a way that will keep your vehicle in a straight line and allow you to turn if it becomes necessary. You can use the "controlled braking" method or the "stab braking" method.

question_translations.question_text: Si debe hacer una parada de emergencia, debe frenar para que:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Manténgase en línea recta y pueda dirigir.

question_translations.question_text: The driver must be able to see a warning that is given before air pressure in the service air tanks falls below:
question_translations.explanation: Low air warning devices (buzzer, light, flag) should activate before air pressure drops below 60 psi or level specified by the manufacturer.

question_translations.question_text: El conductor deberá poder ver una advertencia antes de que la presión del aire en los depósitos de aire de servicio caiga por debajo:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 60 psi

question_translations.question_text: The most common type of foundation brakes found on heavy vehicles is the:
question_translations.explanation: Wedge brakes and disc brakes are less common than s-cam brakes.

question_translations.question_text: El tipo más común de frenos de cimentación que se encuentran en vehículos pesados es:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Freno S-cam

question_translations.question_text: When driving down a long steep hill, you should:
question_translations.explanation: Snub braking method is used for steep downhill grades, in this method apply the brakes just hard enough to feel a definite slowdown. When your speed has been reduced to approximately five mph below your "safe" speed, release the brakes. When your speed has increased to your "safe" speed, repeat.

question_translations.question_text: Al conducir por una colina larga y empinada, usted debe:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Suelte el freno cuando esté 5 mph por debajo de su velocidad "segura".

question_translations.question_text: The modulating control valve is?
question_translations.explanation: In some vehicles, a control handle on the dash board may be used to apply the spring brakes gradually. This is called a modulating valve. It is spring loaded, so you have a feel for the braking action. The more you move the control lever, the harder the spring brakes come on. They work this way, so you can control the spring brakes if the service brakes fail.

question_translations.question_text: ¿La válvula de control modulante es?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Una válvula accionada por resorte que le permitirá poner los frenos lentamente si los frenos de servicio fallan.

question_translations.question_text: Which of the following will be true about your brake function if your antilock braking system (ABS) fails?
question_translations.explanation: Without ABS you still have normal brake functions. Drive and brake as you always have.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de las siguientes afirmaciones será cierta sobre su función de frenos si falla su sistema de frenos antibloqueo (ABS)?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Todavía tendrá la función de freno normal y solo necesitará reparar el ABS pronto.

question_translations.question_text: Which of the following is not part of the braking process when you're driving a tractor-trailer combination vehicle with an antilock braking system (ABS)?
question_translations.explanation: When you drive a vehicle with ABS, you should brake as you always have. In other words: use only the braking force necessary to stop safely and stay in control; brake the same way regardless of whether you have ABS on the bus, tractor, the trailer, or both; as you slow down monitor your tractor and trailer and back off the brakes if it is safe to do so to stay in control.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de las siguientes opciones no forma parte del proceso de frenado cuando conduce un vehículo combinado de tractor y remolque con un sistema de frenos antibloqueo (ABS)?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Debe conducir más rápido para poder mantener el remolque y el tractor rectos.

question_translations.question_text: Which of the following are true about a dual air brake system?
question_translations.explanation: Most heavy-duty vehicles use dual air brake systems for safety. A dual air brake system has two separate air brake systems, which use a single set of brake controls. One system or primary system typically operates the regular brakes on the rear axle or axles. The other or secondary system operates the regular brakes on the front axle and possibly one rear axle.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuáles de las siguientes afirmaciones son ciertas acerca de un sistema de frenos de aire dual?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Todo lo anterior es cierto.

question_translations.question_text: How can you tell if your vehicle is equipped with an antilock braking system (ABS)?
question_translations.explanation: The Department of Transportation requires that ABS be on: air brake vehicles built on or after March 1, 1998.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cómo puede saber si su vehículo está equipado con un sistema de frenos antibloqueo (ABS)?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Compruebe si el vehículo fue fabricado después de 1998.

question_translations.question_text: Spring brakes are
question_translations.explanation: Spring brakes are an important backup system: powerful springs that automatically apply the brakes if they sense that air pressure has been lost for some reason, such as a leak. They will also apply the brakes if the psi gets too low, although ideally, you should take control of your brakes before that happens.

question_translations.question_text: Los frenos de resorte son
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: todo lo anterior.

question_translations.question_text: In the event of a brake system failure, the emergency brake system uses __________ to stop the vehicle.
question_translations.explanation: The emergency brake system uses parts of the service and parking brake systems to stop the vehicle in a brake system failure.

question_translations.question_text: En caso de fallo del sistema de frenos, el sistema de frenos de emergencia utiliza _____ para detener el vehículo.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: partes de los frenos de servicio y frenos de estacionamiento

question_translations.question_text: Repeatedly pressing and releasing (fanning) the brake pedal may result in
question_translations.explanation: Each time you release the brakes, some compressed air leaves the system and must be replenished by the air compressor. If you keep pressing and releasing the brake pedal, air may leave the system faster than the air compressor can replenish it, and the air pressure may drop to the point that the brakes won't work.

question_translations.question_text: Presionar y soltar repetidamente (ventilador) el pedal del freno puede resultar en
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: una pérdida de presión de aire de freno.

question_translations.question_text: If the spring brakes are on, when should you push the brake pedal?
question_translations.explanation: Never push the brake pedal down when the spring brakes are on. If you do, the brakes could be damaged by the combined forces of the springs and the air pressure.

question_translations.question_text: Si los frenos de resorte están encendidos, ¿cuándo debe presionar el pedal del freno?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Nunca

question_translations.question_text: You'll know that your brakes are fading if
question_translations.explanation: As the overheated drums expand, the brake shoes and linings have to move farther to contact the drums, and the force of this contact is reduced. So, you will be pressing harder on the pedal.

question_translations.question_text: Sabrás que tus frenos se están desvaneciendo si
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: tienes que pisar el pedal del freno más fuerte de lo habitual para controlar tu velocidad.

question_translations.question_text: A converter dolly with antilock brakes (ABS) is required to have
question_translations.explanation: Converter dollies built on or after March 1, 1998, are required to have antilock brakes. These dollies will have a yellow lamp on the left side of the dolly.

question_translations.question_text: Se requiere un dolly convertidor con frenos antibloqueo (ABS) para tener
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: una lámpara amarilla en el lado izquierdo.

question_translations.question_text: Which of the following is the most important thing about hard braking?
question_translations.explanation: Emergency braking does not mean pushing down on the brake pedal as hard as you can. That will only keep the wheels locked up and cause a skid. If the wheels are skidding, you cannot control the vehicle.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de las siguientes opciones es lo más importante sobre el frenado brusco?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: No bloquee las ruedas por más de un instante.

question_translations.question_text: In controlled braking, you
question_translations.explanation: You apply the brakes as hard as you can without locking the wheels. Keep steering wheel movements very small while doing this. If you need to make a larger steering adjustment or if the wheels lock, release the brakes. Re-apply the brakes as soon as you can.

question_translations.question_text: En frenado controlado, usted
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: freno en línea recta.

question_translations.question_text: If oil and water collect in the air tanks, what could happen to the brakes?
question_translations.explanation: Compressed air usually has some water and some compressor oil in it, which is bad for the air brake system. For example, the water can freeze in cold weather and cause brake failure.

question_translations.question_text: Si el aceite y el agua se acumulan en los tanques de aire, ¿qué podría pasar con los frenos?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Los frenos podrían fallar.

question_translations.question_text: S-cam drum brakes have an S-cam in each brake chamber. Why is it called an "S-cam?"
question_translations.explanation: The S-cam is S-shaped. The s-cam forces the brake shoes away from one another and presses them against the inside of the brake drum.

question_translations.question_text: Los frenos de tambor S-cam tienen una S-cam en cada cámara de freno. ¿Por qué se llama "S-cam"?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Tiene la forma de la letra "S".

question_translations.question_text: To test the air service brakes,
question_translations.explanation: Pull forward at 5 mph, apply the service brake and stop. Check to see that the vehicle does not pull to either side and that it stops when brake is applied.

question_translations.question_text: Para probar los frenos de servicio neumático,
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: frene firmemente mientras avanza lentamente.

question_translations.question_text: When can you leave your truck unattended without first applying the parking brakes or chocking the wheels?
question_translations.explanation: Never leave your vehicle unattended without applying the parking brakes or chocking the wheels. Your vehicle might roll away and cause injury and damage.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuándo puede dejar su camión desatendido sin aplicar primero los frenos de estacionamiento o asfixiar las ruedas?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Nunca

question_translations.question_text: If your truck or bus has dual parking control valves, it means that you can use pressure from a separate tank to:
question_translations.explanation: When main air pressure is lost, the spring brakes come on. Some vehicles have a separate air tank which can be used to release the spring brakes. This is so you can move the vehicle in an emergency.

question_translations.question_text: Si su camión o autobús tiene válvulas de control de estacionamiento dobles, significa que puede usar la presión de un tanque separado para:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Suelte los frenos de resorte para moverse una distancia corta.

question_translations.question_text: The brake pads should be _____ for the brakes to be on?
question_translations.explanation: To stop, the brake shoes and linings are pushed against the inside of the drum. This causes friction, which slows the vehicle.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Las pastillas de freno deben estar _____ para que los frenos estén encendidos?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Contra el tambor.

question_translations.question_text: You should know that your brakes are fading when:
question_translations.explanation: Increasing application pressure to hold the same speed means the brakes are fading.

question_translations.question_text: Debe saber que sus frenos se están desvaneciendo cuando:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Debe presionar más fuerte el pedal del freno para controlar su velocidad en una bajada.

question_translations.question_text: The application pressure gauge shows the driver how much pressure:
question_translations.explanation: Application Pressure Gauge shows how much air pressure you are applying to the brakes.

question_translations.question_text: El manómetro de aplicación muestra al conductor cuánta presión:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Se está aplicando a los frenos.

question_translations.question_text: If the air compressor should develop a leak, what keeps the air in the tanks?
question_translations.explanation: Installed on the compressor side of the air tank is a one-way check valve, it allows air into the tanks, but does not allow it to flow back to the compressor.

question_translations.question_text: Si el compresor de aire debe desarrollar una fuga, ¿qué mantiene el aire en los tanques?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: La válvula de retención unidireccional

question_translations.question_text: Why drain water from the compressed air tanks?
question_translations.explanation: Compressed air usually has some water and some compressor oil in it, which is bad for the air brake system, the water can freeze in cold weather and cause brake failure. The water and oil tend to collect in the bottom of the air tank. Be sure that you drain the air tanks completely.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Por qué drenar el agua de los tanques de aire comprimido?

question_translations.question_text: Si la señal de advertencia de baja presión de aire no funciona,

question_translations.question_text: Your vehicle has a dual air brake system. One of the systems loses air pressure. What will happen?
question_translations.explanation: A dual air brake system has two separate air brake systems, which use a single set of brake controls. Each system has its own air tanks, hoses, lines, etc. One system typically operates the regular brakes on the rear axle or axles. The other system operates the regular brakes on the front axle and possibly one rear axle.

question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Los frenos delanteros o traseros no estarán completamente operativos.

question_translations.question_text: Under ideal conditions, the average driver of a truck or bus equipped with air brakes and traveling at 55 mph would require what stopping distance?
question_translations.explanation: The total minimum distance your vehicle has traveled, in ideal conditions; with everything considered, including perception distance, reaction distance and braking distance, until you can bring your vehicle to a complete stop. At 55 mph, your vehicle will travel about 450 feet.

question_translations.question_text: Your truck or bus has a dual air brake system. If a low air pressure warning comes on for only one system, what should you do?
question_translations.explanation: The warning light and buzzer should come on before the air pressure drops below 60 psi in either system. If this happens while driving, you should stop right away and safely park the vehicle. If one air system is very low on pressure, either the front or the rear brakes will not be operating fully. This means it will take you longer to stop. Bring the vehicle to a safe stop and have the air brakes system fixed.

question_translations.question_text: Su camión o autobús tiene un sistema de frenos de aire dual. Si se enciende una advertencia de baja presión de aire para un solo sistema, ¿qué debe hacer?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Detente. Estacione de manera segura y continúe solo después de que se haya arreglado el sistema.

question_translations.question_text: If your vehicle has an alcohol evaporator every day during cold weather, you should:

question_translations.question_text: With S-cam drum brakes, when the brake chamber fills with air, air pressure pushes the pushrod out, moving the ________ and thus rotating the ________.

Air pressure pushes the rod out, moving the slack adjuster, thus twisting the brake camshaft. This turns the s-cam. The s-cam forces the brake shoes away from one another and presses them against the inside of the brake drum.

question_translations.question_text: In which of the following situations should you NOT apply the parking brakes?
question_translations.explanation: Don't use the parking brakes if the brakes are very hot (from just having come down a steep grade), or if the brakes are very wet in freezing temperatures. If they are used while they are very hot, they can be damaged by the heat. If they are used in freezing temperatures when the brakes are very wet, they can freeze so the vehicle cannot move. Use wheel chocks instead.
