question_translations.question_text: Outage depends on
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: the type of liquid.

question_translations.question_text: La interrupción depende de
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: el tipo de líquido.

question_translations.question_text: If you steer quickly while braking, your tanker may
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: rollover.

question_translations.question_text: Si conduce rápidamente mientras frena, su camión cisterna puede
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: rollover.

question_translations.question_text: You may not be able to fill the tanks completely because
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: both of the above are true.

question_translations.question_text: Es posible que no pueda llenar los tanques por completo porque
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: ambos anteriores son ciertos.

question_translations.question_text: What should you do if you get stuck on the railroad tracks?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Get out of your vehicle and away from the tracks.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Qué debe hacer si se queda atascado en las vías del tren?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Salga de su vehículo y aléjese de las vías.

question_translations.question_text: A vehicle placarded for hazardous materials must have placards on ____ sides.
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: four

question_translations.question_text: Los carteles de un vehículo para materiales peligrosos deben tener carteles en los lados ____.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: cuatro

question_translations.question_text: How can you start moving without rolling backward?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Do all of the above.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cómo puedes empezar a moverte sin rodar hacia atrás?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Haga todo lo anterior.

question_translations.question_text: You should know the outage needed for the liquids you carry because?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Some liquids expand more than others when they get warm

question_translations.question_text: Debe saber la interrupción necesaria para los líquidos que lleva porque?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Algunos líquidos se expanden más que otros cuando se calientan

question_translations.question_text: You are driving on a clear night, you must dim your headlights from high to low, and should adjust your speed so you can stop within:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: The distance you can see ahead

question_translations.question_text: Está conduciendo en una noche despejada, debe atenuar los faros de alto a bajo, y debe ajustar su velocidad para que pueda detenerse dentro:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: La distancia que puedes ver por delante

question_translations.question_text: Empty trucks:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: May require longer stopping distances than full ones

question_translations.question_text: Camiones vacíos:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Puede requerir distancias de frenado más largas que las completas

question_translations.question_text: Baffles in liquid cargo tanks do not usually prevent the movement of surge from:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Side to side

question_translations.question_text: Los deflectores en los tanques de carga líquida generalmente no impiden el movimiento de sobretensiones de:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: De lado a lado

question_translations.question_text: Liquid-tight separations between compartments inside tanks are called:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Bulkheads

question_translations.question_text: Las separaciones herméticas al líquido entre los compartimentos dentro de los tanques se denominan:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Mamparos

question_translations.question_text: The movement of the liquid in partially filled tanks is called
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: surging

question_translations.question_text: El movimiento del líquido en tanques parcialmente llenos se llama
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: aumento

question_translations.question_text: A tank endorsement is required for certain vehicles that transport
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: liquids or gases.

question_translations.question_text: Se requiere un endoso de tanque para ciertos vehículos que transportan
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: líquidos o gases.

question_translations.question_text: When loading a tank with bulkheads, don't put too much weight on ________ of the vehicle.
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: the front or the rear

question_translations.question_text: Al cargar un tanque con mamparos, no ponga demasiado peso en ______ del vehículo.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: la delantera o la trasera

question_translations.question_text: On a long or steep downgrade, once you have reached your "safe" speed, brake until you are traveling
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: 5 mph slower.

question_translations.question_text: En una bajada larga o pronunciada, una vez que haya alcanzado su velocidad "segura", frene hasta que esté viajando
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 5 mph más lento.

question_translations.question_text: Manhole covers should be
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: closed before you drive the vehicle.

question_translations.question_text: Las tapas de alcantarilla deben ser
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: cerrado antes de conducir el vehículo.

question_translations.question_text: If you do not have an automatic tank drain, when should you drain your air tanks?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: At the end of each working day

question_translations.question_text: Si no tiene un drenaje automático del tanque, ¿cuándo debe drenar sus tanques de aire?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Al final de cada jornada laboral

question_translations.question_text: Exactly how should you inspect your tank vehicle?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Read the vehicle's manual to learn how to do it.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cómo debe inspeccionar exactamente su vehículo cisterna?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Lea el manual del vehículo para aprender cómo hacerlo.

question_translations.question_text: A smoothbore tank is also known as
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: an un-baffled liquid tank.

question_translations.question_text: Un tanque de ánima lisa también se conoce como:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: un tanque de líquido sin desconciertos.

question_translations.question_text: Liquid surge is especially dangerous
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: on slippery roads.

question_translations.question_text: La oleada de líquido es especialmente peligrosa
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: en caminos resbaladizos.

question_translations.question_text: Which of these statements about emergency steering and tankers is true?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: When making a quick steering movement, do not apply the brakes

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estas afirmaciones sobre la dirección de emergencia y los petroleros es cierta?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Al hacer un movimiento de dirección rápido, no aplique los frenos

question_translations.question_text: You should be extremely cautious when driving smooth bore tankers, especially when you are:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Starting or stopping

question_translations.question_text: Debe ser extremadamente cauteloso al conducir camiones cisterna de ánima lisa, especialmente cuando:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Inicio o detención

question_translations.question_text: If you drive a tank vehicle that you know is leaking, you may
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: receive a citation and be prevented from further driving.

question_translations.question_text: Si conduce un vehículo cisterna que sabe que tiene fugas, puede
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: recibir una citación y ser impedido de seguir conduciendo.

question_translations.question_text: If your vehicle is placarded, you must stop _______ feet before the nearest rail at a railroad crossing.
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: 15 to 50

question_translations.question_text: Si su vehículo está rotulado, debe detenerse _______ pies antes del riel más cercano en un cruce de ferrocarril.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 15 a 50

question_translations.question_text: To correct a drive-wheel braking skid, you should
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: stop braking, turn quickly, and counter-steer.

question_translations.question_text: Para corregir un derrape de frenado de la rueda motriz, debe
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: detener el frenado, girar rápidamente y contravirar.

question_translations.question_text: When pre-tripping your tanker, you should check for?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Leaks

question_translations.question_text: Al pre-disparar su camión cisterna, debe verificar?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Fugas

question_translations.question_text: What does liquid surge do to the handling of a tanker?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Surge can move the truck in the direction the liquid waves move

question_translations.question_text: ¿Qué hace la sobretensión de líquido al manejo de un petrolero?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: La sobretensión puede mover el camión en la dirección en que se mueven las ondas líquidas

question_translations.question_text: When hauling 2 tankers, where should the weight be carried?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: To the front

question_translations.question_text: Al transportar 2 petroleros, ¿dónde se debe transportar el peso?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Al frente

question_translations.question_text: You should know that your brakes are fading when:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: You must push harder on the brake pedal to control your speed on a downgrade.

question_translations.question_text: Debe saber que sus frenos se están desvaneciendo cuando:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Debe presionar más fuerte el pedal del freno para controlar su velocidad en una bajada.

question_translations.question_text: The amount of liquid to load into a tank depends on:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: All answers are true

question_translations.question_text: La cantidad de líquido a cargar en un tanque depende de:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Todas las respuestas son verdaderas

question_translations.question_text: Which of these statements about managing space to the sides is true?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: You should avoid traveling next to others whenever possible.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estas afirmaciones sobre la gestión del espacio a los lados es cierta?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Debe evitar viajar al lado de otras personas siempre que sea posible.

question_translations.question_text: Hauling liquids in tank vehicles requires special care for two reasons. One reason is:
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Liquid movement

question_translations.question_text: El transporte de líquidos en vehículos cisterna requiere un cuidado especial por dos razones. Una razón es:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Movimiento del líquido

question_translations.question_text: Loaded tankers are said to have a high center of gravity. What does this mean?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Much of the tanker's weight is high up off the ground.

question_translations.question_text: Se dice que los petroleros cargados tienen un centro de gravedad alto. ¿Qué significa esto?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Gran parte del peso del petrolero está muy por encima del suelo.

question_translations.question_text: A tanker has lost its brakes. When should the driver use a truck escape ramp?
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: Always

question_translations.question_text: Un camión cisterna ha perdido los frenos. ¿Cuándo debe usar el conductor una rampa de escape para camiones?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Siempre

question_translations.question_text: When hauling hazardous materials, you must check any dual tires
question_translations.explanation: Correct answer: C. at the start of each trip and each time you stop.

question_translations.question_text: Al transportar materiales peligrosos, debe verificar cualquier neumático doble
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: al comienzo de cada viaje y cada vez que te detengas. Preguntas y respuestas - Explicación

question_translations.question_text: You should check the height of the trailer before connecting a converter dolly to a second or third trailer. The trailer height is right when:
question_translations.explanation: Make sure trailer height is correct. It must be slightly lower than the center of the fifth wheel, so trailer is raised slightly when dolly is pushed under.

question_translations.question_text: Debe verificar la altura del remolque antes de conectar un dolly convertidor a un segundo o tercer remolque. La altura del remolque es correcta cuando:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: El remolque se levantará ligeramente cuando el dolly convertidor esté respaldado debajo de él.

question_translations.question_text: The best way to stop all skids is to:
question_translations.explanation: When any vehicle starts to skid, you must act to restore traction to the wheels.

question_translations.question_text: La mejor manera de detener todos los derrapes es:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Restaurar la tracción de los neumáticos

question_translations.question_text: When does the driver's manual advise disconnecting the steering axle brakes to help keep the rig straight?
question_translations.explanation: You should never disconnect the steering axel brakes.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuándo aconseja el manual del conductor desconectar los frenos del eje de dirección para ayudar a mantener el equipo recto?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Nunca

question_translations.question_text: When driving with more than one trailer, which trailer should be the first one behind the tractor?
question_translations.explanation: For the safest handling on the road, the more heavily loaded semitrailer should be in first position behind the tractor. The lighter trailer should be in the rear.

question_translations.question_text: Cuando se conduce con más de un remolque, ¿qué remolque debe ser el primero detrás del tractor?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: El remolque más pesado

question_translations.question_text: Driving a truck with double or triple trailers requires a driver to:
question_translations.explanation: Be more careful in adverse conditions like bad weather, slippery conditions, and mountain driving, you must be especially careful if you drive double and triple trailers. You will have greater length and more dead axles to pull with your drive axles than other drivers. There is more chance for skids and loss of traction.

question_translations.question_text: Conducir un camión con remolques dobles o triples requiere que el conductor:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Haz ambas cosas

question_translations.question_text: Which of these will result in the best control on curves?
question_translations.explanation: Slow down to a safe speed, and downshift to the right gear before entering the curve. This lets you use some power through the curve to help the vehicle be more stable while turning.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estos resultará en el mejor control en las curvas?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Reducir la velocidad a una velocidad segura antes de entrar en la curva, luego acelerar ligeramente durante la curva

question_translations.question_text: You are driving a 100' vehicle with double trailers at 30 MPH. The road is dry, and visibility is good. You should keep at least _____ seconds of space ahead of you:
question_translations.explanation: One good rule says you need at least one second for each 10 feet of vehicle length at speeds below 40 mph. At greater speeds, you must add 1 second for safety.

question_translations.question_text: Usted está conduciendo un vehículo de 100 pies con remolques dobles a 30 MPH. El camino está seco y la visibilidad es buena. Debe mantener al menos _____ segundos de espacio por delante:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 10

question_translations.question_text: You are driving with double trailers and must use your brakes to avoid a crash. For emergency braking, you should:
question_translations.explanation: You should brake in a way that will keep your vehicle in a straight line and allow you to turn if it becomes necessary. You can use the controlled braking method or the stab braking method.

question_translations.question_text: Conduce con remolques dobles y debe usar los frenos para evitar un choque. Para el frenado de emergencia, usted debe:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Utilice el frenado controlado o punzante

question_translations.question_text: You are doing a walk-around inspection of a double or triple trailer rig. You should be sure the converter dolly air tank drain valves are _____, and the pintle hook is _____.
question_translations.explanation: Converter dolly air tank drain valve are closed, and make sure pintle hook is latched.

question_translations.question_text: Está haciendo una inspección de una plataforma de remolque doble o triple. Debe asegurarse de que las válvulas de drenaje del tanque de aire del dolly del convertidor sean _____, y el gancho del pivote sea _____.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Cerrado, pestillo

question_translations.question_text: A converter dolly is
question_translations.explanation: A converter gear on a dolly is a coupling device of one or two axles and a fifth wheel by which a semitrailer can be coupled to the rear of a tractor trailer combination forming a double bottom rig.

question_translations.question_text: Un dolly convertidor es
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: un dispositivo de acoplamiento que conecta un semirremolque a la parte trasera de un tractor-remolque.

question_translations.question_text: If a converter dolly has spring brakes, you release the brakes by
question_translations.explanation: Release dolly brakes by opening the air tank petcock, or, if the dolly has spring brakes, use the dolly parking brake control.

question_translations.question_text: Si un dolly convertidor tiene frenos de resorte, suelte los frenos
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: usando el control del freno de estacionamiento de la plataforma rodante.

question_translations.question_text: You have connected the converter dolly to the front semi-trailer and then connected the rear semi-trailer to the converter dolly. How should you test the coupling?
question_translations.explanation: Test coupling by pulling against pin of the rear semitrailer

question_translations.question_text: Ha conectado el dolly convertidor al semirremolque delantero y luego ha conectado el semirremolque trasero al dolly convertidor. ¿Cómo se debe probar el acoplamiento?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Tire contra el pasador del semirremolque trasero.

question_translations.question_text: To test the tractor protection valve, charge the trailer air brake system, turn off the engine, and
question_translations.explanation: Charge the trailer air brake system. Shut the engine off. Step on and off the brake pedal several times to reduce the air pressure in the tanks. The trailer air supply control should pop out or go from "normal" to "emergency" position when the air pressure falls into the pressure range specified by the manufacturer. Usually within the range of 20 to 45 psi.

question_translations.question_text: Para probar la válvula de protección del tractor, cargue el sistema de frenos de aire del remolque, apague el motor, y
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: pisa y baja el pedal del freno varias veces.

question_translations.question_text: If your landing gear is power operated, you should check for ________ during your walk-around inspection.
question_translations.explanation: If the landing gear is power operated, make sure there are no air or hydraulic leaks.

question_translations.question_text: Si su tren de aterrizaje funciona con energía, debe verificar si ___ durante su inspección de recorrido.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: fugas de aire o fluido hidráulico

question_translations.question_text: Coupling a triple trailer is different from coupling other combinations because
question_translations.explanation: A triple combination vehicle has four units (not counting the converter dollies): a tractor and three trailers. You couple a triple as follows: 1. Couple the first trailer to the tractor the same way that you couple any combination vehicle. 2. Couple the third trailer to the second trailer using the method for coupling doubles (which will involve the use of a converter dolly). 3. Move another converter dolly into position. 3. Couple the tractor and first trailer to the second and third trailer using the method for coupling doubles (which will involve another converter dolly).

question_translations.question_text: El acoplamiento de un remolque triple es diferente del acoplamiento de otras combinaciones porque
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: acoplas el tercer tráiler al segundo tráiler antes de acoplarlos al primer tráiler.

question_translations.question_text: The tractor protection valve is designed to close automatically when the air pressure falls into the pressure range specified by the manufacturer, typically
question_translations.explanation: The trailer air supply control should pop out or go from "normal" to "emergency" position when the air pressure falls into the pressure range specified by the manufacturer. Usually within the range of 20 to 45 psi.

question_translations.question_text: La válvula de protección del tractor está diseñada para cerrarse automáticamente cuando la presión del aire cae en el rango de presión especificado por el fabricante, normalmente
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 20 a 45 psi.

question_translations.question_text: In order, the four steps to test your trailer's service brakes are as follows
question_translations.explanation: Wait for normal air pressure, release the parking brake, move the vehicle forward slowly about five mph, and apply the brakes firmly using the trailers hand control. Note any vehicle pulling to one side, unusual feel, or delayed stopping action.

question_translations.question_text: En orden, los cuatro pasos para probar los frenos de servicio de su remolque son los siguientes
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Compruebe la presión de aire normal. Suelte los frenos de estacionamiento. Tire hacia adelante lentamente. Aplique los frenos del remolque, utilizando el control manual si está equipado.

question_translations.question_text: If your test of the tractor protection valve is successful,
question_translations.explanation: The trailer air supply control also called the tractor protection valve control should pop out or go from "normal" to "emergency" position when the air pressure falls into the pressure range specified by the manufacturer usually within the range of 20 to 45 psi.

question_translations.question_text: Si su prueba de la válvula de protección del tractor es exitosa,
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: el control de la válvula de protección del tractor (control de suministro de aire del remolque) se apagará o pasará de "normal" a "emergencia".

question_translations.question_text: To uncouple the rear trailer, the first thing you do is
question_translations.explanation: Park rig in a straight line on firm level ground.

question_translations.question_text: Para desacoplar el remolque trasero, lo primero que debe hacer es
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: estacione el vehículo en línea recta en un terreno firme y nivelado.

question_translations.question_text: A converter dolly with antilock brakes (ABS) is required to have
question_translations.explanation: Converter dollies built on or after March 1, 1998, are required to have antilock brakes. These dollies will have a yellow lamp on the left side of the dolly.

question_translations.question_text: Se requiere un dolly convertidor con frenos antibloqueo (ABS) para tener
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: una lámpara amarilla en el lado izquierdo.

question_translations.question_text: You are driving a 100-foot twin trailer combination at 50 mph. The road is dry, and visibility is good. You should keep at least _____ seconds of space ahead of you.
question_translations.explanation: One good rule says you need at least one second for each 10 feet of vehicle length at speeds below 40 mph. At greater speeds, you must add 1 second for safety.

question_translations.question_text: Usted está conduciendo una combinación de remolque doble de 100 pies a 50 mph. El camino está seco y la visibilidad es buena. Debe mantener al menos _____ segundos de espacio por delante.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 11

question_translations.question_text: Some large trucks have convex or spot mirrors.
question_translations.explanation: The convex mirrors are located below the outside flat mirrors. They are used to monitor the left and right sides at a wide angle. They provide a view of traffic and clearances. These mirrors present a view of people and objects that does not accurately reflect their size and distance.

question_translations.question_text: Algunos camiones grandes tienen espejos convexos o puntuales.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Para hacer que las cosas parezcan más pequeñas y más lejanas de lo que realmente son

question_translations.question_text: Which of these statements about managing space to the sides is true?
question_translations.explanation: Commercial vehicles are often wide and take up most of a lane. Safe drivers will manage what little space they have. You can do this by keeping your vehicle centered in your lane and avoid driving alongside others.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estas afirmaciones sobre la gestión del espacio a los lados es cierta?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Debe evitar viajar al lado de otras personas cuando sea posible

question_translations.question_text: Which of these statements about the handling of doubles and triples is true?
question_translations.explanation: To prevent trailers from rolling over, you must steer gently and go slowly around corners, on ramps, off ramps, and curves. A safe speed on a curve for a straight truck or a single trailer combination vehicle may be too fast for a set of doubles or triples.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estas afirmaciones sobre el manejo de dobles y triples es verdadera?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Un movimiento repentino con el volante puede resultar en un vuelco sobre el remolque trasero

question_translations.question_text: When should you check your mirrors while making a lane change?
question_translations.explanation: Check your mirrors: Before you change lanes to make sure there is enough room. After you have signaled, to check that no one has moved into your blind spot. Right after you start the lane change, to doublecheck that your path is clear. After you complete the lane change.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuándo debe revisar sus espejos mientras hace un cambio de carril?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Todas las respuestas son correctas

question_translations.question_text: Before you can supply air to the air tanks of a second trailer, you need to:
question_translations.explanation: Shut-off valves at rear of trailers, in service and emergency lines. Rear of front trailers: open. Rear of last trailer: closed.

question_translations.question_text: Antes de que pueda suministrar aire a los tanques de aire de un segundo remolque, debe:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Abra las válvulas de cierre en la parte trasera del primer remolque y cierre las válvulas de cierre en la parte trasera del segundo remolque

question_translations.question_text: If you must drive through deep puddles or flowing water, which of these should you not do?
question_translations.explanation: Slow down and place transmission in a low gear. Gently put on the brakes. This presses linings against brake drums or discs and keeps mud, silt, sand, and water from getting in.

question_translations.question_text: Si debe conducir a través de charcos profundos o agua corriente, ¿cuál de estos no debe hacer?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Conduzca rápidamente

question_translations.question_text: During an inspection of a double or triple combination, check the usual things for any combination vehicle and check
question_translations.explanation: To inspect a double or triple, first inspect it just as you would inspect any combination vehicle. Then check that the shut-off valves are open on all trailers but the last trailer. Check each converter dolly to be sure that the pintle hook is properly latched.

question_translations.question_text: Durante una inspección de una combinación doble o triple, verifique las cosas habituales para cualquier vehículo combinado y verifique
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: las válvulas de cierre, el convertidor dolly o dollies, y los frenos de aire en todos los remolques.

question_translations.question_text: When you pull two or three trailers, you should look farther ahead because
question_translations.explanation: Doubles and triples must be driven very smoothly to avoid rollover or jackknife. Therefore, look far ahead so you can slow down or change lanes gradually when necessary.

question_translations.question_text: Cuando tire de dos o tres remolques, debe mirar más adelante porque
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: es más probable que el vehículo se vuelque o navegue.

question_translations.question_text: If you want to couple a second trailer to your combination vehicle, secure it by using
question_translations.explanation: Make sure trailer brakes are locked and/or wheels chocked.

question_translations.question_text: Si desea acoplar un segundo remolque a su vehículo combinado, asegúrelo usando
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Cualquiera de las respuestas puede ser correcta

question_translations.question_text: Which of these statements about quick steering movements and doubles/triples is true?
question_translations.explanation: Rearward amplification causes the crack-the-whip effect. Triples have a rearward amplification of 3.5 meaning you can roll the last trailer of triples 3.5 times as easily as a five-axle tractor. A Double has a reward amplification of 2 being twice as likely to roll over as a five-axel trailer.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estas afirmaciones sobre movimientos rápidos de dirección y dobles/triples es cierta?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Los dobles / triples se voltean desde el movimiento rápido de la dirección más fácil que muchos otros vehículos

question_translations.question_text: The best way to keep brakes from overheating while going down a steep grade is to:
question_translations.explanation: The use of brakes on a long and/or steep downgrade is only a supplement to the braking effect of the engine. The following are the proper braking techniques: Apply the brakes just hard enough to feel a definite slowdown. When your speed has been reduced to approximately five mph below your "safe" speed, release the brakes. When your speed has increased to your "safe" speed, repeat.

question_translations.question_text: La mejor manera de evitar que los frenos se sobrecalienten mientras se desciende una pendiente pronunciada es:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Vaya 5 MPH por debajo de su velocidad segura

question_translations.question_text: Converter dollies:
question_translations.explanation: Converter dollies often do not have spring brakes.

question_translations.question_text: Dollies convertidores:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: A menudo no tienen frenos de resorte

question_translations.question_text: You are driving a set of doubles, and a set of trailer wheels goes into a skid. Which of these is most likely to occur?
question_translations.explanation: Doubles and triples must be driven very smoothly to avoid rollover or jackknife. Therefore, look far ahead so you can slow down or change lanes gradually when necessary.

question_translations.question_text: Estás conduciendo un juego de dobles, y un juego de ruedas de remolque entra en un derrape. ¿Cuál de estos es más probable que ocurra?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Una navaja de remolque

question_translations.question_text: Antilock brakes (ABS) have been required on all converter dollies built since
question_translations.explanation: Truck tractors with air brakes built on or after March 1, 1997 require ABS, and other air brake vehicles such as trucks, buses, trailers, and converter dollies built on or after March 1, 1998 require ABS.

question_translations.question_text: Se han requerido frenos antibloqueo (ABS) en todas las plataformas rodantes convertidoras construidas desde
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Marzo de 1998.

question_translations.question_text: Why must you inspect your double or triple combination vehicle more extensively than a vehicle with only one such semi-trailer?
question_translations.explanation: There are more things to inspect on a double or triple combination vehicle than on a single vehicle. Many of these items are simply more of what you would find on a single vehicle. For example, tires, wheels, lights, reflectors, etc. However, there are also some new things to check.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Por qué debe inspeccionar su vehículo de combinación doble o triple más extensamente que un vehículo con un solo semirremolque de este tipo?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Hay más partes críticas para verificar.

question_translations.question_text: Which of these statements about seeing ahead is true?
question_translations.explanation: Most good drivers look at least 12 to 15 seconds ahead. That means looking ahead the distance you will travel in 12 to 15 seconds. At lower speeds, that's about one block. At highway speeds it's about a quarter of a mile.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estas afirmaciones acerca de ver hacia adelante es verdadera?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Todas las respuestas son correctas

question_translations.question_text: The crack the whip affects trucks with trailers. Which of the following is most likely to tip over?
question_translations.explanation: Due to rearward amplification a double is twice as likely, and a triple is 3.5 times more likely to roll over than a five-axel trailer.

question_translations.question_text: La grieta del látigo afecta a los camiones con remolques. ¿Cuál de los siguientes es más probable que se vuelque?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: El remolque trasero de un triple

question_translations.question_text: A converter dolly consists of a ______ wheel and ________ axles.
question_translations.explanation: A converter gear on a dolly is a coupling device of one or two axles and a fifth wheel by which a semitrailer can be coupled to the rear of a tractor trailer combination forming a double bottom rig.

question_translations.question_text: Un dolly convertidor consiste en una rueda ______ y ejes __.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: quinto; uno o dos

question_translations.question_text: The first step in uncoupling a converter dolly is
question_translations.explanation: Lower dolly landing gear.

question_translations.question_text: El primer paso para desacoplar un dolly convertidor es
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: bajar su tren de aterrizaje.

question_translations.question_text: How can you be sure you supplied air to a second trailer?
question_translations.explanation: Use the tractor parking brake and/or chock the wheels to hold the vehicle. Wait for air pressure to reach normal, then push in the red "trailer air supply" knob. This will supply air to the emergency (supply) lines. Open the emergency line shut-off valve at the rear of the last trailer. You should hear air escaping, showing the entire system is charged.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cómo puede estar seguro de que suministró aire a un segundo remolque?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Vaya a la parte trasera del segundo remolque y abra la línea de emergencia apagada

question_translations.question_text: If a converter dolly is still under the second trailer and you unlock the pintle hook, what will probably happen?
question_translations.explanation: Never unlock the pintle hook with the dolly still under the rear trailer. The dolly tow bar may fly up, possibly causing injury, and making it very difficult to re-couple.

question_translations.question_text: Si un dolly convertidor todavía está debajo del segundo remolque y desbloqueas el gancho de pinza, ¿qué sucederá probablemente?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: La barra de remolque dolly puede volar hacia arriba

question_translations.question_text: You are visually checking the coupling of a converter dolly to the rear trailer. How much space should be between the upper and lower fifth wheel?
question_translations.explanation: Check that the trailer is lying flat on the fifth wheel skid plate with no gap.

question_translations.question_text: Está comprobando visualmente el acoplamiento de un dolly convertidor al remolque trasero. ¿Cuánto espacio debe haber entre la quinta rueda superior e inferior?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Ninguna

question_translations.question_text: When you uncouple twin trailers, the last step is to
question_translations.explanation: Slowly pull clear of dolly.

question_translations.question_text: Cuando desacopla remolques gemelos, el último paso es
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: tire lentamente de la plataforma del convertidor.

question_translations.question_text: Converter dollies
question_translations.explanation: All converter dollies built since 1998 are required to have antilock brakes.

question_translations.question_text: Dollies convertidores
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: a veces no tienen frenos antibloqueo.

question_translations.question_text: You want to hook your combination to a second trailer that has no spring brakes. To do this without wheel chocks, you should:
question_translations.explanation: If the second trailer doesn't have spring brakes, drive the tractor close to the trailer, connect the emergency line, charge the trailer air tank, and disconnect the emergency line. This will set the trailer emergency brakes if the slack adjusters are correctly adjusted.

question_translations.question_text: Desea enganchar su combinación a un segundo remolque que no tenga frenos de resorte. Para hacer esto sin calzos de rueda, debe:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Suministre aire al sistema de aire del remolque con el tractor y luego desconecte la línea de emergencia

question_translations.question_text: Empty trucks:
question_translations.explanation: Empty trucks require greater stopping distances because an empty vehicle has less traction.

question_translations.question_text: Camiones vacíos:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Puede tener mala tracción debido al rebote y al bloqueo de las ruedas

question_translations.question_text: When parking your double or triple combination, you should look for a parking space that you can pull straight through.
question_translations.explanation: Make sure you do not get in a spot you cannot pull straight through. You need to be aware of how parking lots are arranged to avoid a long and difficult escape.

question_translations.question_text: Al estacionar su combinación doble o triple, debe buscar un espacio de estacionamiento que pueda atravesar directamente.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: que puedes tirar directamente.

question_translations.question_text: With the hand valve on, you should test the trailer brakes by opening the service line valve at the rear of the rig. When you do this, you should hear:
question_translations.explanation: Open the service line valve, listen for air to escape, and then close the valve.

question_translations.question_text: Con la válvula manual encendida, debe probar los frenos del remolque abriendo la válvula de la línea de servicio en la parte trasera de la plataforma. Cuando haga esto, debe escuchar:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: El aire se escapa de la válvula abierta

question_translations.question_text: Which of these is not a good thing to do when driving on slippery roads?
question_translations.explanation: When your drive wheels have poor traction, the retarder may cause them to skid. Therefore, you should turn the retarder off whenever the road is wet, icy, or snow covered.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estos no es bueno hacer cuando se conduce en carreteras resbaladizas?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Utilice el freno motor o el retardador de velocidad

question_translations.question_text: Double and triple combination vehicles are ________ stable than other types of commercial vehicles.
question_translations.explanation: Take special care when pulling two and three trailers. There are more things that can go wrong, and doubles/triples are less stable than other commercial vehicles.

question_translations.question_text: Los vehículos combinados dobles y triples son ____
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: menos

question_translations.question_text: You are driving a 100-foot twin trailer combination at 50 mph. The road is dry, and visibility is good. You should keep at least _____ seconds of space ahead of you.
question_translations.explanation: One good rule says you need at least one second for each 10 feet of vehicle length at speeds below 40 mph. At greater speeds, you must add 1 second for safety.

question_translations.question_text: Usted está conduciendo una combinación de remolque doble de 100 pies a 50 mph. El camino está seco y la visibilidad es buena. Debe mantener al menos _____ segundos de espacio por delante.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: 11

question_translations.question_text: Which of these is not a good thing to do when driving on slippery roads?
question_translations.explanation: When your drive wheels have poor traction, the retarder may cause them to skid. Therefore, you should turn the retarder off whenever the road is wet, icy, or snow covered.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Cuál de estos resultará en el mejor control en las curvas?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Reducir la velocidad a una velocidad segura antes de entrar en la curva, luego acelerar ligeramente durante la curva

question_translations.question_text: Which of these will result in the best control on curves?
question_translations.explanation: Slow down to a safe speed, and downshift to the right gear before entering the curve. This lets you use some power through the curve to help the vehicle be more stable while turning.

question_translations.question_text: Conduce con remolques dobles y debe usar los frenos para evitar un choque. Para el frenado de emergencia, usted debe:
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Utilice el frenado controlado o punzante

question_translations.question_text: You are driving with double trailers and must use your brakes to avoid a crash. For emergency braking, you should:
question_translations.explanation: You should brake in a way that will keep your vehicle in a straight line and allow you to turn if it becomes necessary. You can use the controlled braking method or the stab braking method.

question_translations.question_text: Está haciendo una inspección de una plataforma de remolque doble o triple. Debe asegurarse de que las válvulas de drenaje del tanque de aire del dolly del convertidor sean _____, y el gancho del pivote sea _____.
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Cerrado, pestillo

question_translations.question_text: You are doing a walk-around inspection of a double or triple trailer rig. You should be sure the converter dolly air tank drain valves are _____, and the pintle hook is _____.
question_translations.explanation: Converter dolly air tank drain valve are closed, and make sure pintle hook is latched.

question_translations.question_text: Durante una inspección de una combinación doble o triple, verifique las cosas habituales para cualquier vehículo combinado y verifique
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: las válvulas de cierre, el convertidor dolly o dollies, y los frenos de aire en todos los remolques.

question_translations.question_text: During an inspection of a double or triple combination, check the usual things for any combination vehicle and check
question_translations.explanation: To inspect a double or triple, first inspect it just as you would inspect any combination vehicle. Then check that the shut-off valves are open on all trailers but the last trailer. Check each converter dolly to be sure that the pintle hook is properly latched.

question_translations.question_text: Ha conectado el dolly convertidor al semirremolque delantero y luego ha conectado el semirremolque trasero al dolly convertidor. ¿Cómo se debe probar el acoplamiento?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Tire contra el pasador del semirremolque trasero.

question_translations.question_text: You have connected the converter dolly to the front semi-trailer and then connected the rear semi-trailer to the converter dolly. How should you test the coupling?
question_translations.explanation: Test coupling by pulling against pin of the rear semitrailer

question_translations.question_text: El primer paso para desacoplar un dolly convertidor es
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: bajar su tren de aterrizaje.

question_translations.explanation: Lower dolly landing gear.

question_translations.question_text: ¿Por qué debe inspeccionar su vehículo de combinación doble o triple más extensamente que un vehículo con un solo semirremolque de este tipo?
question_translations.explanation: Respuesta correcta: Hay más partes críticas para verificar.
